title: Comeback track
subtitle: Rebuild hand-written Python in four weeks of 1–3 minute reps

stages.title: Week 1 · Syntax & reflexes
stages.tests: Core Python syntax you should type without thinking.
stages.methodology: Type it, run it, read the idiomatic version. Say the TypeScript equivalent out loud.

stages.title: Week 2 · Stdlib & data structures
stages.tests: collections, heapq, itertools, dataclasses, classes, type hints, files, json.
stages.methodology: Reach for the standard library before writing it yourself; know the Big-O of each structure.

stages.title: Week 3 · Problem-solving patterns
stages.tests: Hashing, two pointers, sliding window, stacks/queues, BFS/DFS, sort + binary search, Big-O.
stages.methodology: Clarify → examples → pick a pattern → code → test → state complexity.

stages.title: Week 4 · Practical engineering
stages.tests: Small classes with tests, asserts, tracebacks, async/await, HTTP calls, safe LLM JSON parsing.
stages.methodology: Write the test first, read tracebacks bottom-up, validate every external input.
